ACME-Mobile: Hey, our streaming responses sometimes cut out mid-token when the phone switches APs (wifi -> mobile hotspot). Client sees a truncated JSON chunk and then the socket closes. Happens ~30% of attempts. We pasted the truncated chunk below.
Jordan (Support): Thanks — can you paste the client-side logs + the exact truncated chunk? Also does your client refresh auth tokens while a stream is open?
ACME-Mobile: We do background refreshes (2m TTL). We don't re-open the socket for refresh. Truncated chunk: `{\"choices\":[{\"delta\":{\"content\":\"The quick brown fox\"}}` then nothing, socket closes.
Maria (eng-oncall): Can you repro quickly with curl to determine who closed the connection? Try: ```curl -v -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' 'https://api.redwood.com/v1/streams?model=gpt-test'``` and paste the verbose output.
Ken (eng-runtime): From server logs for your org I see `RST` from client and an IP jump: 34.21.5.10 -> 10.44.32.8 (carrier NAT). Server keeps the old fd until keepalive timeout. We don't currently bind the SSE session to the auth token after handshake, so token refresh shouldn't kill it.
ACME-Mobile: Client logs show OS-level socket closed right when the phone switches to hotspot. No explicit RST from our side.
Jordan (Support): Can you grab a pcap or an Android bugreport? Repro steps we use: 1) Connect to cafe wifi, 2) Start stream, 3) Enable phone hotspot on laptop, 4) Switch phone off wifi -> hotspot, 5) Observe stream.
Ken (eng-runtime): I repro'd on Android 12 (Pixel). Behavior: server sends a final partial chunk, then TCP FIN from cellular NAT; app sees abrupt close and attempts reconnect. Server-side we log `client_closed:ip_mismatch`.
ACME-Mobile: Any server-side config we can toggle quickly? Lower keepalive? Session pinning?
Ken (eng-runtime): Short-term: lower keepalive and reduce TIME_WAIT reclaim so stuck sessions free faster. Longer-term: add a resume mechanism (resume token/last-event-id) so client can reconnect and request continuation; note this requires idempotency on model outputs.
Maria (eng-oncall): Also check intermediate proxies rewriting client source IP — X-Forwarded-For could help if we consider a proxy fingerprint. But that opens security concerns if you trust IP.
Sam (billing): Note on billing: we bill for tokens that were produced and streamed. Partial chunks already sent count. If you want us to credit any aborted requests, DM me a list and we'll review.
ACME-Mobile: For now we'll implement client reconnect that sends last event-id and dedupe on our side if duplicate tokens appear. Could you add a server-side log flag when IP flips mid-session?
Ken (eng-runtime): Yep, adding more detailed logs. I opened INF-4123 to track: \"SSE sessions stuck/abort on client IP change — evaluate keepalive & resume\". Will add an opt-in debug flag for your org.
infra-bot: Ticket INF-4123 created by Ken: \"SSE sessions stuck after client IP change; investigate keepalive and resume options\"
Jordan (Support): Thanks all. ACME-Mobile — please upload the pcap + UA string + Android build to the ticket and we'll iterate. :thumbsup:
